Dialling in espresso on the machine at the café on the corner.

- Dose: 18 g in, 36 g out, in about 28 seconds.
- If the shot runs fast and tastes sour, make the grind size finer.
- If it chokes and tastes bitter, go coarser or lower the dose.
- Change one variable at a time and write it down.

The barista says humidity moves the grinder setting more than a change of beans does.
